_readme: SAIRNlaw deadline engine seed -- Wyoming (W.R.C.P., compiled edition eff. 9-21-26).
Gate: docs/sairnlaw-wyoming-deadline-seed-gate.md (hank b65, 2026-10-29). Every value read verbatim and quoted.

authority.quote: A defendant must serve an answer: (i) within 20 days after being served with the summons and complaint
authority.note: NO service_extension: process; 6(d) also excludes Rule 4(r) mail service of process. effective_from is W.R.C.P. 6's adoption (added February 2, 2017, effective March 1, 2017); the compiled edition read is the one effective 9-21-26.

authority.quote: (ii) within 30 days after being served with the summons and complaint if service is made outside the State of Wyoming
authority.note: A DISTINCT trigger_event: where service happened is a case fact the engine must not guess. effective_from is W.R.C.P. 6's adoption (added February 2, 2017, effective March 1, 2017); the compiled edition read is the one effective 9-21-26.

authority.quote: The responding party must serve its answers and any objections within 30 days after being served with the interrogatories.
authority.note: Stipulated or ordered times are not visible. effective_from is W.R.C.P. 6's adoption (added February 2, 2017, effective March 1, 2017); the compiled edition read is the one effective 9-21-26.

service_extension.note: W.R.C.P. 6(d): "served upon the party by mail or by delivery to the clerk for service, three days shall be added to the prescribed period".

rules.label: Response to a request for production (Wyoming)

authority.quote: The party to whom the request is directed must respond in writing within 30 days after being served.
authority.note: Stipulated or ordered times are not visible. effective_from is W.R.C.P. 6's adoption (added February 2, 2017, effective March 1, 2017); the compiled edition read is the one effective 9-21-26.

service_extension.note: W.R.C.P. 6(d): "served upon the party by mail or by delivery to the clerk for service, three days shall be added to the prescribed period".

rules.label: Response to a request for admission (Wyoming)

authority.quote: A matter is admitted unless, within 30 days after being served, the party to whom the request is directed serves on the requesting party a written answer or objection addressed to the matter and signed by the party or its attorney.
authority.note: A missed date ADMITS the matter. effective_from is W.R.C.P. 6's adoption (added February 2, 2017, effective March 1, 2017); the compiled edition read is the one effective 9-21-26.

service_extension.note: W.R.C.P. 6(d): "served upon the party by mail or by delivery to the clerk for service, three days shall be added to the prescribed period".

authority.quote: A motion for a new trial must be filed no later than 28 days after the entry of judgment.
authority.note: Runs from ENTRY: no 6(d) days. 6(b)(2) forbids extending it. effective_from is W.R.C.P. 6's adoption (added February 2, 2017, effective March 1, 2017); the compiled edition read is the one effective 9-21-26.
